name: Light-Handed Dragon
description: A 3-player game to test (D76, decision 0021), the Heavy-Handed Dragon except the Tail: it only blocks (it captures nothing, gives no check and can't be captured), it is not the Dragon's King, and it moves like a Dragon Head, first off the Coast through A5. The Dragon loses when the Sun, the Moon and both Dragon Heads are captured; then the Tail turns to stone where it stands. Experimental; readings of decision 0021 provisional.
